system.description:
Lightning Release: Spark · cast at D-Rank · no type

2d6 + your Ninjutsu modifier temporary hit points for 1 minute (and 1 hit point).

Resistance to lightning damage while you have them.

Overcharge: the first time you'd take lightning damage, gain bonus temporary hit points equal to half of it instead.
system.summary: 2d6 + your Ninjutsu modifier temporary hit points for 1 minute (and 1 hit point). Resistance to lightning damage while you have them. Overcharge: the first time you'd take lightning damage, gain bonus temporary hit points equal to half of it instead.

rules.text: The creature also gains 1 hit point (the jutsu's own heal).
The resistance lasts only while it has temporary hit points from this jutsu: end the Amp when they're gone.
Overcharge: the first time it would take lightning damage, it instead gains temporary hit points equal to half the damage.
